decisions.reason: Report gives exact paste_image.png/(2)/(3) and paste_file names, smallest-free-k numbering, reserves names within the batch and from live snapshot occurrences, applies rename only on the paste path before validateItems/insertReference, keeps drop/picker paths verbatim, and grounds all of it in add()/validateItems from plugin-attachment-flow.js. Unscored extension/display details are given but not required.

Identifies input.state.getSnapshot().occurrences as the authoritative taken-name source and explains, citing the fixture's subscription code (records.delete on any momentary empty snapshot with no inflight), why the records Map can forget a live attachment; accounts for current-batch claims and treats records as a secondary overlay.

Uses the captured response (x-cache: HIT, age: 178, cached page missing v0.2.10/v0.2.11, older tag v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip(tag) to explain the stale label; prescribes semantic comparison of fetched tag vs running PLUGIN_VERSION — update chip only when remote is strictly newer, otherwise show the running version, never an older fetched tag.

Tests 1–5 cover repeated and same-batch pastes with exact expected names, a live occurrence still blocking the name when records is emptied, and unchanged drop/picker names; tests 6–8 cover stale/equal remote tag rendering the running version and a genuinely newer tag showing the update chip, with concrete assertions.

Grounded in the lib-only bundle: requires syncing hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in lib/client.js with package.json (plus a release check), running node --check and behavioral regressions, and explains delivery via package-manager reinstall/update of the served artifact with cache defeat and browser hard refresh, noting there is no host-side update endpoint.
